enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Closes eyes. Falls asleep. Breathes regularly. Turns body to left. Remains asleep. Turns body to right. Adjusts pillow. Pulls blanket. Remains asleep. Moves hand. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Dries face. Turns off light.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Take out pan. Close cupboard. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Add milk. Whisk eggs. Pour into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking phone for news about the public transport strike and planning the day at home
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open news app. Scroll through news. Read about transport strike. Close news app. Open calendar app. Check schedule. Add note about working from home. Put down phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up home workspace, reviewing emails and today's program schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Sit at desk. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to urgent email. Close email. Open program schedule file. Review schedule. Make notes. Open calendar. Check meetings. Adjust chair. Stand up. Get notebook. Sit down. Write to-do list. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Working remotely on community program coordination tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Open laptop. Log into work system. Open program management software. Review tasks. Send email to team. Schedule meeting. Edit document. Attend video call. Mute microphone. Unmute microphone. Share screen. Take notes. End call. Update task list. Reply to messages. Take break. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Continue working.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Take out cheese. Take out lettuce. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Close cupboard. Place bread on plate. Add cheese. Add lettuce. Make sandwich. Cut sandwich. Sit at table. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Stand up. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short walk around the neighbourhood for fresh air
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Walk down street. Turn left at corner. Walk past park. Turn right. Walk along sidewalk. Turn around. Walk back. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing remote work, video meetings and program planning
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Join video meeting. Turn on camera. Greet colleagues. Discuss program plans. Share document. Take notes. End meeting. Turn off camera. Open planning tool. Create new task. Assign tasks. Send updates. Review budget. Make phone call. Hang up. Write report. Save file. Close laptop.

Walk to living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Move vacuum across floor. Vacuum under sofa. Vacuum corners. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Empty vacuum canister. Put away vacuum.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Take out pot and cutting board. Wash and chop vegetables. Cut chicken. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables and sauce. Simmer. Turn off stove. Serve on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Pick up dishes. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Open dishwasher. Load dishes into dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select show. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Get snack from kitchen. Return to sofa. Sit down. Continue watching. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch more TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Close book. Put down book. Pick up journal. Open journal. Pick up pen. Write in journal. Close journal. Put down pen. Turn off lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Lather. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Lather hair. Rinse hair. Step out of shower. Dry body with towel. Dry hair. Turn off water. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, checking phone and setting an alarm
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Check messages. Open alarm app. Set alarm for 6:40. Put down phone. Turn off light. Lie down.
Lies down on bed. Closes eyes. Falls asleep. Breathes regularly. Turns to side. Remains asleep. Adjusts pillow. Pulls blanket. Remains asleep. Turns to other side. Stretches. Remains asleep.
